snippet.title: Sonki's Lagoon - Reveal Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Sonki's Lagoon is a colorful and funky 3D platform-adventure game. Players explore a mysterious lagoon as Sonki the manta ray, surfing through hand-crafted low poly environments in search of hidden Johnnies.

Explore Gran Lazuli, take on challenges and follow a wacky story filled with odd encounters and (dry) humor!

Wishlist Sonki's Lagoon on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3976150/Sonkis_Lagoon/?utm_source:youtube&utm_content=dateTrailer
